title: Note close, the champion
summary: One close per note: “Your champion retells your pitch to a CFO who never met you.”, the red System Audit button, the quiet Talk to the team and one plain destination.
story: The note ends at its layer (the story map's job for a note), and the line turns the note's argument into the reader's next step. The three notes' lines share no sentence shape.
